label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: Variable 'param' originates from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') (line 13) and flows directly to response.sendRedirect(param) (line 22) without sanitization. Although the redirect is gated by a Referer header check, the Referer header is client-controllable and does not validate the content of 'param'. This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary URLs into the redirect target, constituting an Open Redirect vulnerability consistent with the path-injection risk profile.

evidence.note: User input retrieved via request.getParameter assigned to param
Unvalidated param passed directly to response.sendRedirect sink
